sentences.text: Today, we will talk about a city in Azerbaijan.
This city is called Ganja.
Ganja is an old, calm, and beautiful city.
It has culture, history, and friendly people.
Part two, where is Ganja?
Ganja is in the west of Azerbaijan.
It is the second largest city in the country.
It is close to green mountains and lakes.
The nature around Ganja is peaceful and relaxing.
Part three, a very old city.
Ganja is more than 1,000 years old.
It has a long history.
Many empires lived here.
This makes Ganja an important cultural city in the region.
Part four, Nizami Ganjavi.
Ganja is the hometown of Nizami Ganjavi.
He was a very famous poet.
People in Azerbaijan love him.
There is a big mausoleum for Nizami and Ganja.
Many tourists visit this place every year.
Part five, beautiful architecture.
Many buildings in Ganja are made with red bricks.
This gives the city a special style.
When you walk in the streets, you see old houses, small shops, and narrow roads.
The city looks warm and traditional.
Part six, Khan's Garden.
Ganja has a large green park called Khan's Garden.
It is one of the oldest parks in Azerbaijan.
You can walk, sit, relax, and enjoy nature.
Families come here to spend time together.
Part seven, the Bottle House.
One of the most interesting places in Ganja is the Bottle House.
Yes, a house made with thousands of glass bottles.
A man built this house for his brother.
It is very colorful and unique.
Many people love taking photos here.
Part eight, the Ganja Gates.
Ganja has huge and beautiful gates called the Ganja Gates.
These gates are made of iron.
They are very artistic.
They show the rich culture and history of the city.
Part nine, Ganja Lake areas near Ganja.
There are lakes and forests.
One famous lake is Goygul Lake, only a short drive away.
It has clear blue water.
It looks like a painting.
People love to visit and enjoy the fresh air.
Part 10, Local Food.
Ganja has delicious traditional food.
You can eat Doma, Peaty Soup, and Shaky Halva.
The food is warm, fresh, and full of flavor.
People in Ganja enjoy drinking tea with sugar and jam.
Part 11, Friendly People.
People in Ganja are very kind.
They welcome guests with a smile.
They like to help visitors.
Talking to them is easy and enjoyable.
They are proud of their history and culture.
Part 12, Closing Ganja is a city of history, nature, and warm people.
It is one of the most important cities in Azerbaijan.
If you visit Azerbaijan,
Ganja is a wonderful place to explore.
Thank you for listening to today's episode.
